user.title: Connect GMX mailbox
user.description: Use an app password. POP3/IMAP access must be enabled in the GMX web mailer (E-Mail settings > POP3/IMAP).

data_description.email: The full GMX address; it is also the user name.
data_description.password: Create it under Account > Login & security > App passwords. Required with two-factor authentication.

server.name: Server settings
server.description: Only change these if GMX changes its servers.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate GMX mailbox
reauth_confirm.description: GMX rejected the login for {account}. Either the app password is no longer valid, or GMX switched POP3/IMAP access off after a period of inactivity. Re-enable POP3/IMAP in the web mailer if necessary, then enter the app password.

reconfigure.title: Change server settings
reconfigure.description: Server settings for {account}. The connection is tested with the stored credentials.

error.invalid_email: Please enter a complete email address.
error.invalid_auth_or_imap_disabled: Login rejected. Check the app password and make sure POP3/IMAP access is enabled in the GMX web mailer (GMX switches it off automatically after longer inactivity).
error.smtp_auth_failed: IMAP works, but the SMTP login was rejected.
error.tls_error: The encrypted connection failed (TLS or certificate error).

init.title: GMX mailbox options
init.description: Permissions limit what actions (for example called by an AI assistant) may do. The allowlist is the only hard limit against sending data to third parties.

data_description.permissions: Read is always required. Organize = flags, move, folders, drafts. Delete = move to trash. Send = send, reply, forward.
data_description.allow_permanent_delete: Also needs the Delete level and a confirmation token for each call.
data_description.allow_html_output: Lets get_message return the message as cleaned HTML (format html): layout and full link addresses are kept; scripts, comments, hidden elements and images are removed. Off: text only.

data.allow_reply_to_sender: Allow replies to the original sender

data_description.send_mode: Off: no sending. Allowlist: only listed recipients. Any recipient: requires the entry * in the list.
data_description.allowlist: Exact addresses or *@domain. An empty list blocks sending. Enter * only together with the mode 'Any recipient'.
data_description.allow_reply_to_sender: Replies to the sender of a message even if the sender is not on the allowlist.
data_description.sent_copy_mode: GMX does not store a copy of messages sent via SMTP, so the integration appends one.

limits_section.name: Limits
limits_section.description: Freely adjustable (at least 1). GMX does not publish its sending limits; high values can lead to a temporary account block.

data_description.idle_renew_minutes: GMX closes idle connections after about 30 minutes; at most 25 minutes.

folders_section.name: Special folders
folders_section.description: Leave empty for automatic detection (SPECIAL-USE, then folder name).

data.event_include_headers: Include sender and subject in events

data_description.event_include_headers: Event data ends up in the logbook and recorder and can reach an AI assistant.

error.invalid_allowlist_entry: Invalid allowlist entry. Use exact addresses, *@domain or *.
error.wildcard_requires_any: The entry * is only allowed with the send mode 'Any recipient'.
error.any_requires_wildcard: The send mode 'Any recipient' must be confirmed by adding the entry * to the allowlist.
error.invalid_sent_copy_mode: Unknown mode for the Sent copy.
error.out_of_range: A value is outside the allowed range.

invalid_auth_or_imap_disabled.message: GMX rejected the login. The app password may be invalid or POP3/IMAP access may have been switched off.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot connect to the GMX mail server.

tls_error.message: The encrypted connection to the GMX mail server failed.

permission_disabled.message: The permission level {permission} is not enabled in the options of this account.

auth_failed.message: GMX rejected the login. Reauthenticate the integration; POP3/IMAP access may have been switched off.

folder_not_found.message: The folder {folder} does not exist or cannot be opened.

uidvalidity_changed.message: The folder was rebuilt on the server (UIDVALIDITY changed). Search again to get valid references.

message_not_found.message: The message no longer exists in this folder.

attachment_not_found.message: The message has no part with this ID.

attachment_too_large.message: The attachment is larger than allowed (max_bytes; base64 at most 256 KB).

search_rejected.message: The server rejected the search criteria.

imap_error.message: The IMAP server returned an error.

invalid_cursor.message: The cursor is invalid or belongs to a different search.

path_not_allowed.message: The media folder is not an allowed path in Home Assistant (allowlist_external_dirs).

html_output_disabled.message: HTML output is not enabled in the options of this account.

imap_possibly_disabled.title: GMX login rejected for {account}
imap_possibly_disabled.description:
GMX rejected the login. GMX switches POP3/IMAP access off automatically after a longer period without use, and then reports the same error as for a wrong password.

1. Log in to the GMX web mailer.
2. Open E-Mail settings > POP3/IMAP and allow POP3 and IMAP access (GMX asks for a security confirmation).
3. If the app password was deleted, create a new one under Account > Login & security > App passwords.
4. Then reauthenticate the integration under Settings > Devices & services.

uidvalidity_changed.title: Folder rebuilt on the server for {account}
uidvalidity_changed.description: The UIDVALIDITY of the folder {folder} changed. Mail references obtained earlier (folder, uid, uidvalidity) are no longer valid; search again. No new-mail events were sent for this change.

folder_mapping_ambiguous.title: Special folders ambiguous for {account}
folder_mapping_ambiguous.description: More than one folder could be the special folder for: {roles}. The folder shown was chosen. If that is wrong, pick the folder in the integration options under Special folders (for example when an old Sent folder from another mail client exists next to Gesendet).

server_rules_unavailable.title: GMX filter rules cannot be managed
server_rules_unavailable.description: GMX offers no interface for the filter rules of the web mailer (no ManageSieve, not visible via IMAP). The GMX Mail integration therefore cannot read or change these rules. You can ignore this notice.

list_folders.name: List folders
list_folders.description: Lists all folders with their special role (inbox, sent, drafts, trash, spam).

include_counts.name: Include counts
include_counts.description: Also return the number of messages and unseen messages per folder (one STATUS command per folder).

search.name: Search messages
search.description: Searches a folder and returns message summaries page by page. New messages appear in GMX's full-text index only after about 30 seconds; recent messages are then checked by their headers.

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Folder path, e.g. INBOX or Gesendet.

cc.name: CC
cc.description: Text contained in the CC recipients.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text contained in headers or body.

since.name: Since
since.description: Received on or after this date.

include_snippet.name: Include snippet
include_snippet.description: Add a short text preview (up to 160 characters) per message.

get_message.name: Get message
get_message.description: Returns headers, the sanitised text and the attachment list of a message. Does not mark it as read.

ref.name: Message reference
ref.description: Object with folder, uid and uidvalidity as returned by search.

format.name: Format
format.description: Which part to return and how: text, HTML converted to text, cleaned HTML (only if enabled in the options) or all headers.

max_chars.name: Maximum characters
max_chars.description: Maximum number of text characters in this response.

headers.name: Additional headers
headers.description: Names of further headers to return.

get_attachment.name: Get attachment
get_attachment.description: Saves an attachment under /media/gmx_mail or returns small attachments as base64.

ref.name: Message reference
ref.description: Object with folder, uid and uidvalidity as returned by search.

part_id.name: Part ID
part_id.description: part_id from the attachment list of get_message.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Save as a file or return base64 (only up to 256 KB).

get_status.name: Get status
get_status.description: Returns capabilities, the special-folder mapping, the number of unseen messages in the inbox and the active settings.
